CustomField.description: Set by GR staff on a Legislator Account where outreach needs coordinating. When checked, any Task or Event logged against the Account by a team other than GR notifies the GR_Team public group. Does not restrict logging - it is a notify-on-touch flag, not a lock.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this if GR needs to know whenever another team logs an interaction with this legislator. Other teams can still log activity as normal.
CustomField.label: Outreach Sensitivity
